request: Fix the /archive Step 5 ordering defect. Step 5 (verifyAndApplyDelta) runs after Step 3 (archive.sh), which git-mv's docs/specs/<slug>.md into the archive bundle; resolveSpecPath then returns null and delta.mjs:285 falls through to parseDelta('') — producing an all-empty verdict indistinguishable from a spec that declared no delta, so a real drift would archive silently green. Two-part fix: (1) reorder Step 5 before Step 3 in .claude/skills/archive/SKILL.md with an explicit before-Step-3 warning mirroring the one Step 2 already carries for the approval token, pinned by a structural test; (2) report a specMissing flag from verifyAndApplyDelta when the spec cannot be resolved, mirroring the existing inputEmpty flag, so the failure stays loud even if the ordering is ever changed back.
novelty_evidence: delta.mjs:185 and :275-276 already carry `inputEmpty` as the established precedent for distinguishing a broken input from an honest empty result, tested at tests/system-spec-delta-archive-verify.test.mjs:230-231. The comment at delta.mjs:280-284 documents this exact failure class being closed once already for the epic-child pin case. .claude/state/tdd/system-spec-delta-slice-c.json:13 records the governing principle verbatim: the two results must be 'distinguishable by shape, not only by array length'. Observed instance recorded in landmine archive-step-5-reads-the-spec-after-step-3-has-moved-it during the ship-baseline-output-style landing (commit 6fdd6ee). Step 2 of the same SOP is the ordering-warning precedent to copy.
